state_summary.problem: Portal selected-game events can still enqueue newly registered catalog IDs while their game contexts disable external collection pending Worker registration.
state_summary.expected: New game021 through game025 do not send external events while their Worker registration is pending, including Portal events that encode them as envelope.game_id.
observed: TelemetryService option remoteCollectionEnabled false is checked on the current context by AnalyticsRuntime.record.
Portal creates TelemetryService without that option and emits game_card_impression, game_card_click and game_launch with selected_game.
AnalyticsRuntime.send uses selected_game as envelope.game_id for Portal events.
unknown: No compiled browser enqueue or production HTTP response was measured for the new IDs.
Root integration of catalog/new-ID Portal filtering is not yet complete.
state_summary.operation: Consent-granted Portal displays or launches a newly added classic-five game card.

codex_independent_judgment.rationale: Per-context collection suppression on new game pages does not apply to Portal selected-game events because Portal creates an enabled context. send substitutes selected_game as envelope game_id, including pending-registration IDs. This violates the intended suppression scope and can produce rejected analytics requests. It does not prevent gameplay or important player controls, so this specific issue is not independently classified as major unresolved player-facing release risk. Central registration filtering plus targeted enqueue tests can repair it while preserving existing IDs.

actual_next_action.description: Read complete TelemetryService and AnalyticsRuntime, then followed Portal impression/click/launch selected_game through record→send→envelope. Preserved contemporaneous state and executed one hidden-answer Shadow record only after root explicitly requested it. No browser or production request measurement.
